apps.name: PandaApps
apps.description: This store — install and update native Minima apps (SHA-256 verified). Falls back to IPFS if GitHub is unreachable, so it keeps working. Official-app UPDATES download to your Downloads to install manually; first-time installs go direct.

apps.name: Terminal IDE
apps.description: Professional developer tooling for the Minima protocol — a full node terminal with autocomplete and offline help for every command, a KISS VM smart-contract editor (lint, offline test in the node's own VM, deploy) and a guided transaction workbench. 0.1.5: large responses arrive in full via the new minimaapi (needs Minima Core New UI 1.3.0+ for results over 256KB).

apps.name: Zero Edge Casino
apps.description: Provably-fair on-chain casino — coin flip, dice and roulette via a 3-phase commit-reveal contract. Zero house edge. v0.6.2: the bet maker now sees its exact win/lose result the instant the taker resolves (reads the resolve transaction on-chain).

apps.name: Minima UTXO Wallet
apps.description: Full UTXO wallet — send & receive, split/consolidate coins, token balances and transaction history.

apps.name: Minima History
apps.description: Browse and export your node's full transaction history, with on-chain verification.

apps.name: Minima Vestr
apps.description: Token-vesting contract manager — create and track scheduled token releases on Minima.

apps.name: FutureCash
apps.description: Send Minima or tokens to the future — lock funds until a block you choose; the recipient collects when it matures. Interoperable with the FutureCash MiniDapp.

apps.name: Minima Limit
apps.description: On-chain limit-order DEX for MINIMA/USDT — place buy & sell orders at your price; trustless full-fill swaps via a VERIFYOUT smart contract. Good-till-cancelled orders auto-renew so they never expire. Shares the same order book as the Limit MiniDapp.

apps.name: minimaSwap
apps.description: Trustless cross-chain atomic swaps between native MINIMA and Ethereum USDT — HTLC hash-locked, no custodian. Makers publish a DEPTH LADDER (up to 6 bid + 6 ask tranches, each its own price and size) and takers can MARKET-SWEEP — a large order fills best-price-first across multiple levels/makers as sequential atomic swaps, with a transparent avg/worst-price review. Aggregated on-chain order book, per-take cap matching, embedded ETH wallet, both directions, background swap watcher, and a network-wide trade history. Interoperable with the miniSwap/bridge MiniDapp. An OTC tab for negotiated peer-to-peer deals — LPs advertise side+size, an instigator proposes/counters/accepts over a sealed channel, and the deal settles as a trustless HTLC swap. AUTO MARKET-MAKE — peg your maker ladder to the live MEXC MINIMA/USDT market: it auto-reprices when the market moves and auto-withdraws for safety if the feed goes down, restoring on recovery. Your published market stays LIVE until you cancel it — the app self-heals after reboots, node restarts and deep sleep and alerts you if Minima Core is down so the market can be reinstated the moment connection returns. NEW (0.18.0): ETH-leg fund-safety hardening — a dropped/replaced Ethereum transaction now retries and confirms on-chain instead of stranding funds, lock timelocks anchor to chain time (not the device clock), gas is floored to the base fee, and Tether approvals self-repair; it now also SAFELY coexists with usdtSwap on the same node (a shared-wallet tx clash just retries, never loses funds). Under the com.eurobuddha namespace — uninstall any old minimaSwap install first (finish open swaps before switching).

apps.name: usdtSwap
apps.description: Trustless cross-chain atomic swaps between ERC20 USDT (Ethereum) and native USDT on Minima (mxUSDT) — HTLC hash-locked, no custodian. A fork of minimaSwap with the Minima leg repointed to mxUSDT (the bridged native-USDT token) and PARITY pricing: because both legs are USDT the mid is fixed at 1.0 and you set a skew + spread around it (no external price feed). Reuses minimaSwap's aggregated on-chain order book, depth-ladder market-making (up to 6 bid + 6 ask tranches), best-price-first market-sweep taking, OTC negotiation tab, embedded ETH wallet, both directions, and a background swap watcher — on its OWN isolated books, so it never mixes with minimaSwap. v0.1.2: mainnet-verified end-to-end (both directions, small swaps) and hardened — a dropped Ethereum tx retries instead of stranding funds, lock timelocks anchor to chain time, gas is floored to the base fee, and Tether approvals self-repair; backed by a unit-test suite over the fund paths. Still experimental — test with small amounts. Requires Minima Core running with usdtSwap enabled.

apps.name: AtomiX
apps.description: minimaSwap + usdtSwap combined into ONE app — pick your currency from the header pill and swap either native MINIMA ↔ ERC20, or bridged native-USDT (mxUSDT) ↔ ERC20 USDT. Trustless HTLC atomic swaps, no custodian. You publish and market-make in ONE currency at a time, and switching currency re-themes the whole app to that identity (Minima orange ↔ Tether green) and moves your market to that book — the legacy per-currency order books, so AtomiX interoperates with existing minimaSwap / usdtSwap peers. Background settlement is currency-agnostic: switching currency NEVER strands an in-flight swap in the other one. Carries the full feature set (depth-ladder market-making, best-price market-sweep taking, OTC tab, embedded ETH wallet, both directions, background watcher) plus the claim-path reliability hardening. v0.1.11: fund-safety — a harvested HTLC preimage is now verified to hash to the lock before it is trusted, so a forged on-chain reveal (the notify sink is anyone-can-write) can no longer poison the secret store and block your claim. v0.1.9: the Wallet tab gains Send — move ETH or USDT out to any address, with balance and gas checks, a Max button and a review step. v0.1.8: settlement hardening — a claim now verifies the received coin is the right token before completing, a mismatched counterparty lock can no longer hold up a valid claim, and the responder’s timing guard reads Ethereum chain time. v0.1.7: when several makers quote the same best price, a swap now fills the DEEPEST maker first — so a fillable amount uses one swap instead of splitting into extra legs (a strictly better price still always wins). v0.1.6: the live order book refreshes every ~90s and re-checks the maker at take time, so a market a maker has WITHDRAWN can no longer show as tradeable. v0.1.5: switching currency TOMBSTONES your live market on the old book and REMEMBERS each currency's market. v0.1.3: ladder defaults to a SINGLE level (multi-leg opt-in, up to 6) and the AtomiX atom icon. EXPERIMENTAL; test small.

apps.name: Minima Terminal

Note: 1.2+ is eurobuddha-signed - updating over the Spartacus-signed 1.1 needs an uninstall first.

apps.name: Minima Wallet
apps.description: Self-custodial Minima wallet — signs locally, uses Minima Core only as a NON-admin relay (works with node admin OFF). PRE-VERIFICATION TEST BUILD: viewing balances + receiving is safe; do NOT send real funds until on-device verification confirms a transaction lands on-chain. Coins received are always recoverable from your seed. When importing a seed, enter how many signatures it has already used (over-estimate if unsure) — this protects against reusing a one-time key.

apps.name: FreezePeach
apps.description: Censorship-resistant, self-custodial chat on the MaxLite off-chain network. Your identity is your Minima seed — the same on any device — end-to-end sealed, no phone number, no account, no server that can read or block you. Premium two-theme design, scan/paste contacts, short IDs, group chats with media + admins, rich sealed photos/video, and a full photo editor: filters, adjust, crop, rotate, markup, plus a native retro-effects studio (filtr, ported to OpenGL ES): dithering & palettes, halftone, edge-detect, ASCII art, CRT, scanlines, RGB-split, bloom, grain. Now includes a full non-custodial in-app Minima wallet: local WOTS signing (seed never leaves the device), send to any address or straight to a contact from the chat with a payment bubble, token icons + names + web-validation checkmarks, and a live balance.

apps.name: PandaPools
apps.description: Constant-product AMM liquidity pools on Minima — swap MINIMA/token across aggregated micro-pools, provide liquidity and earn the 0.5% swap fee. Trustless VERIFYOUT covenant; pools are good-till-cancelled and discovered from a shared on-chain registry. Interoperable with the PandaPools MiniDapp (same pools).
